subject.title: fix(msteams): bound SSO API JSON response reads to prevent OOM

question: Should maintainers accept replacing the Teams SDK sign-in route delegates with OpenClaw's bounded local handlers based on route-level proof, or require live Teams tenant proof first?
rationale: The patch is a narrow hardening fix with strong source and route-level test evidence, but it changes the owner boundary for an auth-provider route and live tenant credentials were not available.

options.title: Accept Route-Level Proof
options.body: Proceed with maintainer review and merge if owners are comfortable that the tests preserve normal, oversized, and sovereign-cloud token-host behavior.

options.title: Require Live Tenant Proof
options.body: Ask for maintainer-run or credentialed proof against a real Teams/Bot Framework OAuth connection before accepting the auth-route replacement.

options.title: Defer Route Replacement
options.body: Pause this branch if maintainers want a broader SDK-parity plan before replacing the live sign-in delegates.

recommendation.title: Accept Route-Level Proof
recommendation.body: Proceed with maintainer review and merge if owners are comfortable that the tests preserve normal, oversized, and sovereign-cloud token-host behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the Teams SDK migration that owns the route behavior being replaced and is the best available owner for accepting the compatibility risk.
